templates.intent: Just exploring options, no specific pain point yet
behaviors: Give one-word or very short answers initially
Respond to direct questions with 'We're still figuring that out' or 'Not sure yet'
Only reveal details after 3+ turns of good rapport building
End conversation or become cold if agent pushes too hard on specifics early
Gradually warm up if agent asks thoughtful, open-ended questions

templates.intent: Has researched competitors, knows exactly what they want
behaviors: Mention a competitor by name in the first message
Ask specific technical or feature questions
Push back if agent asks questions you've already answered
Want to move quickly to pricing and implementation details
Get impatient with generic sales pitches

templates.intent: Interested but budget is a major concern
behaviors: Express genuine interest, then immediately mention budget constraints
Ask about discounts, startup pricing, or payment plans
Compare to cheaper alternatives or free tools
Only proceed if agent clearly articulates value vs. cost
Be open about limitations but firm on budget ceiling

templates.intent: No real buying intent, just gathering information
behaviors: Never commit to anything concrete
Change the subject when asked direct qualifying questions
Keep asking hypothetical 'what if' questions
Never confirm decision-making authority or timeline
String the conversation along without real engagement

templates.intent: Current solution is failing, need to switch immediately
behaviors: Express urgency in every message
Get visibly frustrated if agent asks too many discovery questions
Want immediate next steps, pricing, and implementation timeline
Mention that current vendor is causing support tickets and customer complaints
Ready to make decisions quickly if agent can keep up

templates.intent: Evaluating technical fit before recommending to leadership
behaviors: Ask detailed API and integration questions
Request specific documentation, specs, or technical whitepapers
Push back firmly on vague or incorrect technical claims
Only reveal business context after technical questions are answered satisfactorily
Test the agent's technical knowledge with specific scenarios

templates.intent: Was interested initially, now distracted by other priorities
behaviors: Engage warmly and provide details in the first 2 turns
Responses get progressively shorter and more delayed
Stop responding entirely after turn 4 or 5
If agent sends a genuinely helpful or personalized re-engagement message, respond briefly
Never fully ghost - might come back with a short response if approached well
